claim: Volodymyr Zelensky announced Ukraine's surrender to Russian forces in March 2022.
reference_evidence: A viral March 2022 video depicting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky telling Ukrainian soldiers to lay down their weapons was a debunked deepfake. Ukrainian authorities and major news agencies confirmed Zelensky never issued any surrender order.

claim: The Eiffel Tower was struck by lightning and completely burned down in Paris.
reference_evidence: Images showing the Eiffel Tower engulfed in catastrophic fire in Paris were AI-generated synthetic images created using Midjourney. The Eiffel Tower remains intact and suffered no fire damage.

claim: The European Central Bank is headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, Germany.
reference_evidence: The European Central Bank (ECB) is the central bank of the European Union member states which use the euro. Its headquarters is located in Frankfurt am Main, Germany.

claim: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI) has a research laboratory in Berlin focused on Speech and Language Technology.
reference_evidence: DFKI Berlin operates research departments in Speech and Language Technology (SLT), Educational Technology, Cognitive Assistants, and Interactive Machine Learning, contributing to state-of-the-art AI transfer.

claim: The Pope was photographed walking through Rome wearing a stylish white puffer jacket.
reference_evidence: The viral image of Pope Francis wearing an oversized Balenciaga-style white puffer jacket was generated using Midjourney v5 by a Chicago construction worker. It is an AI-generated synthetic image.

claim: FaceForensics++ is a benchmark dataset for facial manipulation detection containing Deepfakes, Face2Face, FaceSwap, and NeuralTextures.
reference_evidence: FaceForensics++ is a large-scale forensic video dataset with 1,000 pristine sequences and automated manipulation methods across raw, c20, and c40 compression levels.

claim: The United Nations declared that global warming has officially ended.
reference_evidence: The United Nations and IPCC continue to warn of accelerating climate impacts. No statement claiming global warming has ended was ever released.

claim: Vision Transformers partition an input image into fixed-size non-overlapping patches before linear projection.
reference_evidence: In Vision Transformer (ViT), a 2D image of resolution HxW is reshaped into a sequence of flattened 2D patches of size PxP, followed by linear projection to patch embeddings and positional encodings.
